scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.setup:hooks: ln -sf ../../.githooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/pre-commit && chmod +x .githooks/pre-commit && echo '✅ Pre-commit hook установлен'
